name: P008 fixed six-pair client query wall comparison
summary: Prospective protocol thread-post:1143257 completed six alternating control/candidate pairs on one read-only REPEATABLE READ backend. Candidate query client wall improved with identical returned row digests. Query component only; no full-tool, HTTP, host-adoption or shipment claim.

assertions.evidence: Four ABBA warmups followed by six complete AB/BA pairs; every collected sample is preserved in measurement.
All sixteen SELECTs returned 300 rows with one identical sorted full-row digest.
No planner flags forced. Post-timing EXPLAIN without ANALYZE reports broad work_items scan for control and hfc_item_kind_idx for candidate.
Production query, cache adapter, database connection and bootstrap CI source hashes match before/after.

executionNote: Exact script below was passed to node on quoted-heredoc stdin. stdout was captured to /tmp/cache-p008-client-wall-cold69.json; stderr was empty; exec_command reported exit_code 0. No new measurement is run by recording this artifact.

queries.control: SELECT feature_id, item_kind, harness_slug, title, summary, status, taken_by, taken_at, last_progress_at, parent_id, NULL::jsonb AS payload, needs_design, design_status, design_spec_id, discarded_design_work, assignee_rank, rank_writer, rank_updated_at, feature_order, created_ts, updated_ts, origin, audit_verdict, verified_author_github_user_id, terminal_owner, terminal_completion_ref, authority, closed_ts, goal_id, tags, source_plan_slug, source_plan_item_ids, redundancy, expected_cost_cents FROM harness_shared.harness_features_consolidated WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id='') AND (item_kind='feature' OR item_kind IN (SELECT work_item_kind FROM harness_shared.datatype_registry WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND tier='generic-kind' AND status='active' AND work_item_kind IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY updated_ts DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 300
queries.candidate: SELECT feature_id, item_kind, harness_slug, title, summary, status, taken_by, taken_at, last_progress_at, parent_id, NULL::jsonb AS payload, needs_design, design_status, design_spec_id, discarded_design_work, assignee_rank, rank_writer, rank_updated_at, feature_order, created_ts, updated_ts, origin, audit_verdict, verified_author_github_user_id, terminal_owner, terminal_completion_ref, authority, closed_ts, goal_id, tags, source_plan_slug, source_plan_item_ids, redundancy, expected_cost_cents FROM harness_shared.harness_features_consolidated WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND harness_slug='papercusp' AND (parent_id IS NULL OR parent_id='') AND item_kind = ANY(ARRAY(SELECT 'feature'::text UNION SELECT work_item_kind FROM harness_shared.datatype_registry WHERE workspace_id='papercusp-workspace' AND tier='generic-kind' AND status='active' AND work_item_kind IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY updated_ts DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 300

Plans.Filter: (((parent_id IS NULL) OR (parent_id = ''::text)) AND (workspace_id = 'papercusp-workspace'::text) AND (harness_slug = 'papercusp'::text) AND (item_kind <> ALL ('{bug,change,task}'::text[])) AND ((item_kind = 'feature'::text) OR (ANY (item_kind = (hashed SubPlan 1).col1))))

limitations: Only the feature-family query component is measured, through the current production connection builder.
One backend and one repeatable-read snapshot; shared database/host were not isolated from unrelated traffic.
Rows are compared as sorted full-row multisets; stable ordering among equal updated_ts values is not asserted.
R7 freshness/accounting/semantic proofs remain separate ledger-backed test bindings.
No provider inference, cache TTL/invalidation change, deployment, or host-process adoption verification.
